thread:
noah: hi all — Noah here, started on eng-runtime this morning. quick blockers: need VPC network access + role to push dedicated model images to the redwood-dedicated registry for a quick proof-of-concept. who should I open requests with? first-week demo on Thursday so trying to speed this up.
jamie (People Ops): welcome @noah :wave: theres a VPC onboarding form on the onboarding hub (https://intranet.redwood.ai/onboarding). fill that out and cc infra. also put your manager on the request so we can expedite demo-related items.
rafa (infra): hey @noah — infra handles subnet/VPC and security group adds. open a ticket in #help with subject "vpc-access: <name>" and include: GitHub, requested subnets/CIDR, reason, and expiration. for registry permissions we need the project name and DockerHub/GCR account. SLA for these is usually 24-48 hours, faster if tagged as demo.
sophie (platform): adding — platform grants the deployer role for dedicated. DM me your GitHub username and the repo name (or the image tag) and I can create a short-lived deploy key until org invites land. if you need CI creds set, tell me whether you want a robot user or personal token.
carla (eng-manager): @noah if this is demo-critical, escalate with page on PagerDuty and add me and @rafa. also include a link to the runbook: https://kb.redwood.ai/dedicated-deploy-runbook which lists pre-reqs.
rafa (infra): sample ticket body to paste into #help: 
```
Subject: vpc-access: noah
- Github: noahGH
- Repo/image: github.com/redwood/runtime-demo -> registry.redwood.ai/runtime-demo:pr-42
- Buckets needed: s3://redwood-internal, s3://redwood-artifacts
- Subnet request: 10.41.16.0/24
- Owner: Noah (eng-runtime), Manager: Carla
- Purpose: internal demo Thurs 2026-03-26
- Requested expiry: 2026-03-27
```
onboard-bot: Request queued (id=onb-2142601245). You will be notified in this thread for updates.
noah: thanks — I filed the ticket and pinged @sophie with my GH handle. sending PagerDuty page now since demo is time-sensitive.
sophie (platform): invite pre-staged. once infra confirms network and registry ACLs Ill flip the deploy perms. will post here when done.
rafa (infra): acknowledged, moving to high-priority. expected to complete network + ACL changes within 12 hours. will update ticket and this thread.
carla (eng-manager): thanks team :heart: let us know if anything else is needed for the demo.
